description:
GitHub Download, https://github.com/OfflcerSam/NavalSector/releases
While I was in the middle of making this a year ago, I have since then kind of abandoned it. But I didn't want to let it rot too much in the back corner.

Requires, Nexerelin, MagicLib, LazyLib, and GraphicsLib
(No clue if this works with random generation, cause I forgot to test it.)

Like the TankSector mod I made, it functions and plays. Due to burnout I haven't worked on it in a year, so maybe one day I'll come back to mess with it.

What does this mod do?
Adds in many WW2 Naval Ships on the US side and my personal faction inspired by French stuff.
(Was going to have 1.0 have atleast have Germany and Japan but lol)

Also adds in some Naval related hullmods, that may or may not be balanced.

Also every Naval Ship has a boat load of built-in PD, this is obviously not balanced in the slightest to vanilla but I thought it would be funny.

This mod is not meant to be serious in any manner, just a reminder.

Current content:

Faction:
United States Naval Command (USA, USA, USA)
Sampstonial Republic Admiralty Council (Personal faction, was going to be French/British inspired)

Star Systems:
Star of Hope (USNC)
Star of Stonia (SRAC)

these may or may not be copies and may or may not balanced, i dont particularly remember.

aiDescription: Adds a variety of World War II naval ships, including fighters, destroyers, cruisers, and battleships, for the United States Naval Command and the Sampstonial Republic Admiralty Council. Includes new weapons such as naval guns, torpedoes, and bombs, along with naval-related hullmods. Ships feature extensive built-in point defense, though balance is not guaranteed.
